summary: Updated workflow specification §18.3 in auxiliary-systems.md. The auto_handoff pseudocode now shows the AGENT_NAMES[nextAgent] lookup (sourced from personas/name-mapping.json) and the three new fields: cc_agent_name (e.g. '3-developer'), vs_agent_name (e.g. '3 - Developer v3.6.1'), and da_agent_name. The existing agent_name and agent_id fields are unchanged. A blockquote note explains the data source and backward compatibility. All 3 acceptance criteria satisfied.
